rules.title: Provenance and rights are mandatory
rules.description: Every candidate declares source class, locator, retrieval date, and rights status.

rules.title: Winston owns review
rules.description: Every candidate declares @winston as review owner, next review date, and review freshness.

rules.title: Promotion requires executable evidence
rules.description: Executable promotion requires ADR, Native rule, OPA policy, and fixtures.

rules.title: Topology contract completeness
rules.description: Every candidate declares maturity, preconditions, anti-patterns, alternatives, and related topologies.

rules.title: Source registry linkage
rules.description: Every candidate links to a valid SRC-* source registry entry and every SRC-* entry links back to its KI-* candidates.

rules.title: Promotion state machine
rules.description: Promotion transitions must follow candidate → evaluated → accepted → executable; any status may transition to retired. No skipping stages.

rules.title: Promotion evidence and disposition
rules.description: Non-candidate statuses require promoted_at and promoted_by. Accepted/executable require a non-null ADR. Retired requires a non-null disposition reason.
